statement: Both CL-044 regression files are present in the canonical generated primary, resource, and subsystem classification manifests, so selective CI cannot silently skip either proof; manifests match the live test census and remain derived from their single-owner rules.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Treat classification drift as a system ownership defect first: inspect manifest history and the canonical derivation owners before changing generated bytes; never hand-maintain individual entries.
Primary, resource, and subsystem manifests are regenerated from the same live census and land together; the exact delta contains only the two CL-044 test entries plus derived counts and digests.
